name: cip_nightly
description: Nightly pipeline. Each state calls a function that exists and is tested locally; the Circuit adds orchestration and retry, not logic.
comment: A Circuit does NOT schedule itself. Catalyst Cron is what invokes a Circuit on a schedule (Cron's schedule points are: a function, a third-party URL, or a Circuit). The nightly 02:00 IST schedule therefore lives on the `cip_nightly_trigger` cron in catalyst.json, not here -- an earlier `schedule` block in this file was not a Circuits field and would never have fired.

ingest.comment: Consume NDJSON batches from Stratus into raw, then curated.

data_quality.comment: Run the DQ suite. A blocking failure stops the run rather than publishing untrustworthy gold tables.

halt.cause: One or more blocking data-quality checks failed. Curated data was not promoted.

intelligence.comment: Entity resolution, graph rebuild, embeddings, hotspots, early warning, priority scores.

retention.comment: Purge expired conversation state. Audit rows are never purged here.
